targets.query: from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: median)

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column))

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: (tables=<-, column) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.99, column: column))

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "k6") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vus" and r.environment == "${environment}" and r.run_id == "${run_id}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max)
